comment: Every quantitative claim published in README.md, docs/**.md and examples/** at ad91026 (the 2026-08 era boundary: endogenous macro chain, avg_volume fix, MARKET_FACTOR_SIGMA recalibration, per-domain RNG substreams), with the method that produces it. `group`/`key` point into tools/remeasure/measures.py; `compare` says how close a re-measurement must land to count as reproducing the published value. `source` says whether the method is stated on the page, reconstructed from tests/docstrings, or unknown. Rows with compare.kind == 'none' carry a status_override instead of being measured. Timing-derived quantities are never judged at printed precision: the recording overhead in particular is a median of interleaved pairs judged against a band or a bound, because the point is below the wall-clock noise floor.
